time: Daily CoinMetrics BTC PriceUSD from previous UTC date d-1, no exchange actual fill; UTC daily date cannot infer reaction hour. For policy effective date distinguish communication announced date (main event) vs effective date (metadata).
measures: Pre-event 7d/30d BTC returns, day-of, forward day 1/3/7/14/30/90 min/max and closing returns. Keep results descriptive; market anticipatory pricing and contemporaneous shocks confound.
studyLimits: This is additional POST-HOC selected historic shock sequence, not independent news-prediction precision. Do not classify war as US GDP gain or global risk absence, nor classify Apr9 2025 as one-dimensional good/bad.
hypothesis: Market-wide removal of trade restrictions may be larger relief for global risk appetite than China-only changes; separate reach by jurisdictions and weighted trade rather than inventing quantitative benefit. Defense orders may boost US defense employment without implying net US macro GDP gain. Risk impact BTC contingent on aggregate yields, USD, inflation, BTC positioning and source surprise.
